proposals.tactic:
rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (show 0 ≤ (60 : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) by positivity), ← Real.sqrt_mul (show 0 ≤ (60 : ℝ) * (x : ℝ) * (12 * (x : ℝ)) by positivity)]
calc
  _ = Real.sqrt ((36 * (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (35 * (x : ℝ))) := by
    congr 1
    ring
  _ = _ := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (show 0 ≤ (36 * (x : ℝ)) ^ 2 by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (show 0 ≤ 36 * (x : ℝ) by positivity)]

let a : ℝ := Real.sqrt (60 * (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (12 * (x : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (63 * (x : ℝ))
let b : ℝ := 36 * (x : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (35 * (x : ℝ))
change a = b
have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; positivity
have hs : a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only [a, b]
  simp only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 60 * (x : ℝ) by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 12 * (x : ℝ) by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 63 * (x : ℝ) by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 35 * (x : ℝ) by positivity)]
  ring
have hf : (a - b) * (a + b) = 0 := by nlinarith only [hs]
rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hf with h | h <;> linarith only [ha, hb, h]
